Help [[Infantryman Hareh]] raise an undead army.

==Quest information==

===Objectives===
* Escort Hareh to the ancient graveyard in [[the Sulfurous Wastes]].
* Visit [[gravesite]]s and help Hareh summon the undead. You have visited 0 of 5 gravesites.
* Protect Hareh while he performs the ritual to raise the undead.
* See [[Infantryman Hareh]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 2,500 [[Experience]]
* 200 [[Gold]]
* [[Ancient Artifact]]

==Walkthrough==
Follow the quest marker to come to a spot with five [[gravesite]]s located near each other. Infantryman Hareh will follow you (he is [[undead]], so don't worry about him not being inside a [[Junundu]]). The quest marker will point you successively to all five of the gravesites. At each gravesite, Infantryman Hareh will use the skill [[Rise From Your Grave!]] to animate two level 18 [[Undead Soldier]]s (they look like [[Flesh Golem]]s). You do not need to click on the gravesites. Just get Hareh to follow you close enough to trigger his use of that skill.

After Hareh animates each pair of his [[minion]]s (unlike normal minions, these will not have inherent [[health degeneration]]), a group of about 6 [[Margonite]]s will attack your position. Being inside [[Junundu]] will make the fight easy, but note this will prevent you from using healing skills on [[Infantryman Hareh]], so consider having a monk outside of the wurm if you have trouble keeping him alive. Don't worry about the Undead Soldiers dying. Once Hareh has activated his skill for the fifth time, the quest is considered complete and you can claim the quest from him before the fifth group of Margonites arrives.

==Dialogue==

===Initial dialogue===
'''Infantryman Hareh'''
:''"Now that we've found the ancient tome, I have all the tactical knowledge I need to be a superb commander! Just holding it makes me feel smarter. But I can't be a commander without troops.... I know this is a lot to ask, but could you help me raise an '''undead army'''? Just a little one? There's a '''graveyard''' nearby that should work. I'd do it myself, but the demons have a tendency to attack anyone they find wandering alone."''

|accept = Undead armies are good.
|decline = That time I raised my first bone minion...let's just say things got a little messy. No thanks.
|ask = What're we waiting for? Let's go find those graves in the '''Sulfurous Wastes'''! }}

===Reward dialogue===
'''Infantryman Hareh'''
:''"Thank you for your help! Now that I have some servants of my own, I can surely prove my worth as a commander! If you ever need anything, just let me know. I'm in your debt!"''

==Trivia==
*Hareh's dialogue line of ''"Good. Bad. I'm the guy with the minions."'' is a play on on the line ''"Good. Bad. I'm the guy with the gun."'' used by Ash in the comedy/horror movie [[W:Army of Darkness|Army of Darkness]].
